resources.string: Catalog snapshot of expected APIs: %1$s · expected site access: %2$s. Click checks the current AMO package before installing.

Tap “Install in Click” here, or open the official AMO listing in Click and use its “Add to Firefox” button. For page-triggered downloads, Click asks you to confirm before checking the current Android Recommended status. GeckoView then validates the Mozilla signature and compatibility and shows the permission prompt. A downloaded XPI can still be imported, but the same allowlist and safety checks apply.
This catalog currently contains only Mozilla add-ons Recommended for Firefox Android. Click rechecks the live AMO record at install time; remove an installed add-on before replacing its ID.

Only curated add-ons currently Recommended for Firefox Android are eligible. Installs run in the isolated GeckoView profile; sensitive browser APIs, broad or insecure site access, Chrome CRX files and arbitrary extensions/scripts are not supported.
